citations.long: There is no quality control unit.
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality or purity of the drug product.
Specific identification tests are not conducted on components that have been accepted based on the supplier's report of analysis.

citations.short: Control procedures to monitor and validate performance
citations.long: Control procedures are not established which monitor the output and validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may be responsible for causing variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.
Procedures designed to prevent objectionable microorganisms in drug products not required to be sterile are not established.
Each batch of drug product required to be free of objectionable microorganisms is not tested through appropriate laboratory testing.
Written records are not made of investigations into unexplained discrepancies and the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet specifications.
All compounding and storage containers used during the production of a batch of drug product is not properly identified at all times to indicate contents.

citations.short: Control procedures to monitor and validate performance
citations.long: Control procedures are not established which monitor the output and validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may be responsible for causing variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.

citations.short: Control procedures to monitor and validate performance
citations.long: Control procedures are not established which monitor the output and validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may be responsible for causing variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.
The accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility of test methods have not been established.

citations.short: Batch production and Batch Control Record Requirements
citations.long: The batch production and control records are deficient in that they do not include documentation of the accomplishment of each significant step in manufacturing.
The batch production and control records are deficient in that they do not include the identity of major equipment used.

citations.short: Calculations performed are in the records
citations.long: Laboratory records do not include a record of all calculations performed in connection with the test.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.
GMP training is not conducted on a continuing basis to assure that employees remain familiar with CGMP requirements applicable to them.

There are no written procedures for production and process controls designed to assure that the drug products have the identity, strength, quality, and purity they purport or are represented to possess.
Laboratory controls do not include a determination of conformance to written descriptions of sampling procedures for drug products.
The written stability program for drug products does not include sample size based on statistical criteria for each attribute examined to assure valid estimates of stability.

citations.short: Labeling: documentation of exam and review
citations.long: There is no documentation of the examination and review of labels and labeling for conformity with established specifications.

citations.short: Prepared for each batch, include complete information
citations.long: Batch production and control records are not prepared for each batch of drug product produced.
